# Cuemath

> Online K-12 math tutoring platform offering personalized one-on-one learning through certified tutors using the gamified MathFit platform

Cuemath provides comprehensive math education from 2nd grade through 8th grade and beyond, covering algebra, geometry, and advanced topics. The platform combines live online tutoring with structured curriculum aligned to US standards, featuring interactive lessons, formula references, and problem-solving techniques.

## Algebra Formulas & Identities

- [(a - b)^3 Formula | A Minus B Whole Cube Formula](https://www.cuemath.com/a-b-cube-formula): Algebraic identity for (a-b)³ expansion with derivation and examples
- [A Cube Minus B Cube Formula | a^3 - b^3 Formula](https://www.cuemath.com/a-cube-minus-b-cube-formula): Difference of cubes factorization formula a³-b³=(a-b)(a²+ab+b²)
- [A Minus B Whole Square Formula - Examples | (a - b)^2 Formula](https://www.cuemath.com/a-minus-b-whole-square-formula): Binomial square identity (a-b)²=a²-2ab+b² with geometric derivation
- [a^2 - b^2 Formula - Examples | A Square - B Square Formula](https://www.cuemath.com/a-square-minus-b-square-formula): Difference of squares formula a²-b²=(a+b)(a-b) for factorization
- [Absolute Value - Meaning, Sign, Examples | How to Find Absolute Value?](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/absolute-value): Beginner guide to absolute value magnitude and modulus on number lines
- [Absolute Value Inequalities. - Solving, Graph, Formula, Examples](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/absolute-value-inequalities): Solving and graphing absolute value inequalities with algebraic methods
- [Adding and Subtracting Polynomials](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/adding-and-subtracting-polynomials): Polynomial operations tutorial covering like terms and standard form

## Set Theory & Venn Diagrams

- [A union B Formula - A U B, Venn Diagram, Examples](https://www.cuemath.com/a-union-b-formula): Set theory union formula A∪B with Venn diagrams and De Morgan's laws
- [A union B Complement - Formula, Proof, Examples](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/a-union-b-complement): De Morgan's law proof for (A∪B)'=A'∩B' with set complement operations
- [A Intersection B Intersection C - Definition, Formula, Notation, Examples, FAQs](https://www.cuemath.com/algebra/a-intersection-b-intersection-c): Set theory triple intersection A∩B∩C notation and Venn diagrams

## Geometry & Coordinate Systems
